meta.name: seo-page
meta.description: URL-level SEO intelligence — which keywords this page ranks for, traffic captured, position history, SERP context, and AI Search citation status. Produces a keep / refresh / consolidate / kill verdict for one page. Distinct from `seo-technical-audit` (which checks technical health, not keyword/traffic performance) and from `seo-content-brief` (which produces a NEW article from a topic). Use when the user asks "analyze this page", "page SEO performance", "what does this URL rank for", "page traffic", "should I refresh this page", or provides a single URL for analysis.

copy.tagline: 分析单页的SEO表现并给出优化建议
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想知道某个网页的搜索排名和流量表现。
